name: Greek Avgolemono (Egg-Velvet Chicken & Rice Soup)
whyItWorks: Thickens rich chicken bone broth and white rice using tempered egg yolks instead of heavy dairy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Temper whisked eggs with hot chicken broth and stir into cooked white rice and shredded chicken. Skip citrus zest/peel extracts; season with salt and a pinch of dried dill.
